Important Dates

  • Exam Conducting Body : Tamil Nadu Public Service Commission (TNPSC)
  • Exam Name : Combined Civil Services Examination-I (Group I Services)
  • Hall Ticket Release Date : 17 September 2026
  • Exam Date : 27 September 2026 (Sunday)
  • Exam Timing : 9:30 AM to 12:30 PM (Forenoon session)
  • Exam Duration : 3 hours (180 minutes)
  • Exam Mode : Offline
  • Admit Card Mode : Online download only

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Visit the official website.

  3. Enter your registration number / roll number and date of birth / password.

  5. Download and take a printout. Carry it to the exam center along with a photo ID.
